name: go-dockerclient-c08eda54-blind28-ots
instr:
# Diagnosing go-dockerclient's wrong answers and misrouted requests without a test suite

Driving a workload service through this library, a wide spread of calls began answering wrongly, and some no longer answer at all. The repository has received 28 separate undocumented edits.

The loudest group is the calls that only ask questions and now succeed silently while handing back nothing. Asking for the enumeration of running units, with the service replying with a perfectly good array of four entries, yields an empty slice and no error. Asking for the named data stores the service keeps — the ones with a driver, a mount location and a timestamp for when they were made — does the same: an empty result, no complaint. Requesting the space-consumption report, which the service answers with layer sizes plus per-unit and per-store detail, gives back nothing and again no error. Asking to reclaim space from unused assembly leftovers, and separately asking to reclaim space from units that are no longer running, both report success with an empty summary in place of the deleted identifiers and the reclaimed byte count. Deleting an installed add-on by name, and asking for the privilege detail of an add-on by name, likewise hand back an empty structure and no error even though the service sent the full description. Each of these needs its own repair; mending one leaves the rest silent.
